sc_missing_integrity: {package} has no integrity hash in the lockfile, so the downloaded artifact is not verified.
sc_missing_hash: {package} has no hash pinned in the lockfile, so the downloaded artifact is not verified.
sc_registry_not-https: {package} is resolved from a non-HTTPS source ({source}).
sc_registry_untrusted-host: {package} is resolved from a registry that is not a trusted public one ({source}).
sc_registry_git-source: {package} is resolved from a git source ({source}), not from a registry artifact.
sc_unpinned_source: {package} comes from {source} without a pinned commit.
sc_unpinned_version: {package} is not pinned to an exact version.
sc_unreadable: {file} could not be read: {detail}. Nothing is concluded about it.
sc_no_packages: {file} lists no packages; nothing is concluded about it.
sc_no_lockfile: No npm or Python lockfile was found; the supply chain is unknown, not clean.
sc_unknown_python_deprecation: Deprecation of Python packages needs the package index (network); this offline check marks it unknown.
sc_blocked: The supply-chain check could not run.
sc_no_invocation: The plan has no supply-chain invocation for the instance {tool}.
sc_reason_completed: {count, plural, one {# supply-chain finding} other {# supply-chain findings}} in {lockfiles, plural, one {# lockfile} other {# lockfiles}}; {unknown, plural, one {# signal} other {# signals}} unknown (offline read, never counted as clean).
sc_limitation_offline: Supply chain: reads npm and Python lockfiles offline; the deprecation of Python packages and release age need a registry and stay unknown, never clean.
sc_condition_fail_on: Findings of severity {level} or higher block (none: they are only reported).
sc_condition_install_scripts_allowed: Install scripts are reported but do not block.
sc_condition_install_scripts_blocked: Install scripts are findings of high severity and follow blockOn.
sc_condition_lockfiles: {count, plural, one {# lockfile is analyzed} other {# lockfiles are analyzed}}.
sc_setting_allow_install_scripts: {tool}: allowInstallScripts must be true or false, not {value}.
sc_setting_list: {tool}: {setting} must be a list of non-empty text.
sc_setting_lockfile_path: {tool}: lockfiles must be paths inside the workspace (no absolute path, no ..).
